article.title: Seal of registering officers.
article.content: The several Registrars and Sub-Registrars shall use a seal bearing the following inscription in English and in such other language as the 2[State Government] directs:—“The seal of the Registrar (or of the Sub-Registrar) of”.
article.html:
15Seal of registering officers.

Section 15 · Part II · page 8 of the Act

The several Registrars and Sub-Registrars shall use a seal bearing the following inscription in English and in such other language as the 2[State Government] directs:—“The seal of the Registrar (or of the Sub-Registrar) of”.

2 Subs. by Act 4 of 1914, s. 2 and the Schedule, for “the Local Government fills up the vacancy”.
